message: You know, getting the kids to understand the importance of storm preparedness is like trying to get them to eat their vegetables—lots of eye-rolling and playful grumbling. But I’ve found that having a little chat about what to do when a storm is brewing can really help. It’s not just about the snacks you stash away; it’s about keeping everyone on the same page, even if that page is a bit soggy from the rain. How do you get your little ones involved in emergency prep? 🌧️
